run_video_object_segmentation: run EdgeTamVideoModel forward to segment objects in a video frame using point or mask prompts
propagate_video_tracking: propagate EdgeTamVideoModel through video frames to track objects across the entire sequence
build_inference_session: build an EdgeTamVideoInferenceSession to manage video inference state, caching, and object tracking
create_prompt_embeddings: create prompt embeddings from input points, boxes, or masks using EdgeTamVideoPromptEncoder
get_image_embeddings: get image embeddings from pixel values using the vision encoder and FPN feature maps
